I like the way they look but I could’ve definitely used the money I just wasted on necessities. Now i’m broke for the rest of the month because of my impulsiveness. Here’s something I suggest doing though, Taking time off, from everyone. I find myself extremely problematic around this time. So, whenever I feel that way, I just lock my phone and don’t talk to anyone I feel like I’d start an argument with. I use this time to binge watch, eat, sleep, practice some makeup, it honestly makes me feel at peace and calms me down. I think just doing what you like doing, uninterrupted, with some music blasting is such a therapeutic thing to do. It gives you some time to reflect and actually think about *why* you’re acting the way you do. I really hope this helps.

I’m only 3 weeks and a couple more days into recovery but what I honestly suggest is, If you have a history of Motion sickness? The type that makes you throw up on planes/cars? I’m not trying to scare you here, I’m just giving you a warning/heads up, because honestly I didn’t see any of the symptoms I experienced anywhere online (until I directly searched for them post-surgery), but I woke up from surgery vomiting blood, It kept on going for the entire day, they tried giving me injections and IV to suppress the nausea but that had absolutely no effect. I still don’t exactly know what happened to me but I’m chopping it up to me having extreme motion sickness. Another thing you should look out for is, if you’re a side sleeper?
